note:
Functions over 80 lines in addons/mail/static/src, 54 -> 50, as a side effect of the comment/docstring strip across the module. Not a structural win and not claimed as one: none of the five that fell was shortened by extraction, only by losing prose. useMessageScrolling 96, _handleNotificationNewMessage 88, RecordList.splice 85, _collectCSSRules 85 and peer_to_peer._sendNotifications 82 all sat within 16 lines of the budget and dropped under it once their comments went.

One function moved the OTHER way and is included in the 50: DiscussCoreCommon.setup, previously under the budget, is now 83. The sweep replaces prose above a bus callback with a JSDoc @param block INSIDE the subscribe() call, and prettier then breaks the two-argument subscribe(name, arrow) across lines to fit it. That is four new lines per callback and the method has five. Comment stripping is therefore not monotonic for this gate -- it removes lines from function bodies and adds them back wherever a type annotation lands inside a call expression.

The five real offenders the earlier note named -- thread_model_patch setup, core/common/thread setup, mail_popout_service start, makeStore, store MAKE_UPDATE -- are all still over, at 222, 194, 236, 205 and 193. Shrinking Thread is still what moves this number.

Command: python tooling/architecture/js_function_length.py --addon mail --count
